content.text: [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/selling-digital-products-without-stripe-honest-side-side-9|selling]] a digital product should be a simple transaction. You build something valuable — an ebook, a course, a Notion template, a font family, a preset pack, a beat — and someone pays you for access to it. The file transfers. The transaction completes. But for millions of creators, the [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/usdt-payment-gateways-digital-products-explained-digital-creators-9|COREMERCH guide to payment]] layer is where [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/everything-you-need-know-about-nowpayments-integration-static-11|Everything You]] breaks down. Stripe is unavailable. PayPal flags the account. Gumroad holds the payout. The workarounds stop working. What actually works is a sovereign commerce stack: a static storefront on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, automatic payment verification through NOWPayments, and delivery triggered by a webhook the moment the transaction confirms on-chain. No platform intermediary. No payout schedule. No geography filter. The customer owns the storefront code, the order history, the customer list, and the product files. COREMERCH has no access after deployment.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/complete-deep-dive-automated-digital-product-delivery-crypto-2. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.
content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Bitcoin payment

Selling digital products like ebooks, courses, and templates is often hindered by platform fees from services like Gumroad. With fees reaching 10% per sale, it becomes critical to find alternatives that minimize costs. Bitcoin payments through NOWPayments, which charge only 0.5%, provide a viable solution. This approach not only reduces transaction costs but also enhances autonomy, allowing creators to fully control their sales without relying on restrictive platforms.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The infrastructure for accepting Bitcoin payments for digital downloads involves several key components. You can use GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting your store, paired with Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for handling backend logic. When a customer makes a purchase, NOWPayments verifies the transaction on-chain at a minimal fee, ensuring a secure and efficient payment process. This architecture allows for seamless delivery of digital products without the interference of traditional payment gateways.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This payment architecture is specifically designed for digital creators who operate in regions where conventional payment platforms are inaccessible. Individuals selling ebooks, online courses, or other digital goods often find themselves constrained by high fees and limited options. By adopting a Bitcoin payment system, these creators can not only bypass these obstacles but also maximize their earnings while establishing a more robust and independent online presence.
NOWPayments offers the lowest fees in the industry for Bitcoin transactions.
The Components That Make It Work Together

Key components that enable this architecture include hosting solutions for your storefront, payment processors for handling Bitcoin transactions, and file delivery systems for instant access to purchased products. Using GitHub Pages or Cloudflare for hosting, combined with NOWPayments for crypto transactions, creates a cohesive ecosystem that allows creators to manage their entire sales process. This setup ensures that you retain complete ownership of your data and sales, enhancing your sovereignty in the digital marketplace.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To start selling digital products with Bitcoin payments, first choose a hosting platform like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Next, set up your backend logic using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to handle transactions. Integrate NOWPayments for cryptocurrency payment processing. Finally, organize your digital products in a storage solution like Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 and ensure delivery links are operational. With these steps, you can launch your independent digital store quickly.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

You can sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe by using an infrastructure that accepts Bitcoin payments. Implementing a solution with NOWPayments allows you to process crypto transactions easily, reducing fees significantly compared to traditional platforms. This gives you more revenue from each sale while ensuring a seamless customer experience.
Ownership of your digital store means complete control over your sales and customer data.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

If you're interested in building an independent online store without reliance on PayPal or Gumroad, consider exploring The Sovereign Blueprint ($47). This comprehensive guide provides all the documentation and resources you need to set up a successful digital sales architecture using Bitcoin. Check it out at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Prepare your product files in delivery-ready format — PDF for ebooks, ZIP archives for multi-file products, exported files for Notion templates, OTF and TTF archives for font families. Set your prices in USD and let NOWPayments handle the crypto equivalent calculation automatically at transaction time. Deploy your stack and configure the product list with file paths, USD prices, and delivery settings. Configure your storefront with product pages and checkout flow. Test the checkout on both desktop and mobile — confirm QR codes generate correctly and live price feeds display accurately. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link. Check your order database and confirm the test transaction appears with all correct fields.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I set up Bitcoin payments for my digital products?

To set up Bitcoin payments, choose a hosting platform and a backend technology to manage transactions. Use NOWPayments for processing crypto payments. Follow their integration guide to connect your store and enable Bitcoin as a payment option.
What are the fees associated with using NOWPayments?

NOWPayments charges a 0.5% fee on every transaction, which is significantly lower than typical fees from platforms like Gumroad. This reduction allows you to keep more profit from each sale, enhancing your overall revenue.
Can I sell multiple products using this Bitcoin system?

Yes, you can sell multiple digital products using this setup. With the right infrastructure, you can easily manage and sell various items such as ebooks, courses, and templates all under the same store.
Is customer data secure in this system?

Absolutely. Since you own the entire infrastructure, customer data remains secure and private. Unlike traditional platforms, there is no third party involved in your transactions, ensuring complete control over your data.
What types of digital products can I sell with Bitcoin payments?

You can sell a wide range of digital products, including ebooks, online courses, templates, fonts, presets, and software. The flexibility of this infrastructure allows for the easy addition of new products as you grow.
